changes_in_this_build: Separate opt-in, read-only chat access to saved Notes, open Thoughts and cached COROS readings
Native tool-call loops for Anthropic and tool-capable OpenAI-compatible providers
Two lookup rounds, four local reads and 16000 characters of tool results per reply
Lookup requests and final answer share the selected reply-token budget; reported usage totals cover all completed rounds
Provider and exact endpoint-bound access grants; recipient changes reset access and revocation stops active replies
Dated and bounded COROS summaries with freshness indicators; no background refresh or credentials sent
Stepped 12 fps pixel cube loader with thinking and reading status; reduced-motion and lifecycle support
Transient tool protocol/results; visible chat history stays local and outside Drive sync
Existing prompt caching, encrypted keys, streaming Markdown and Stop/Retry preserved
known_limits: Live provider APIs and handset gestures have not been exercised; no tests, lint or paid API calls were run
Compatible providers require streamed chat completions and function tool support when Pocket access is enabled
COROS uses only the current local cache; Movement must refresh missing or stale readings
Cache discounts depend on provider, model, minimum prompt size and prefix reuse; each lookup round bills input and output remains billed
Tool results are transient; subsequent questions may retrieve relevant records again, and prior answers remain until New chat clears the conversation
No chat attachments, write tools, tasks, draft notes, photos or COROS credentials
Existing release signing key is unavailable, so no installable incremental update was produced
